comments.story: Valve has mutated from a game developer into a financial middleman

comments.author: hatsunearu
comments.story: Valve announces Artifact, a Dota 2 card game
comments.text: The audience reaction and the logo popping up is comedy gold. [VIDEO] Context: Valve hasn't released any new IP other than steamVR for 7 years, and has multiple game franchises that have hordes of fans desperately asking for a (third) sequel.
